name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-platform-gateway
description: NestJS gateway that runs one DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Host per project behind the platform shell

scripts.db:migrate: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.db:revert: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:revert -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.db:show: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:show -d dist/database/data-source.js
